contexts.text: Some species of trees signify exterior goods and truths, which are of the natural man; as the poplar, hazel, and plane-tree.
Hazel and plane-tree () = the power thence of natural Truths. The hazel and plane tree = natural Truths.
Fir-trees, and plane-trees () = natural things... plane-trees, as to truth.
On the north were groves full of plane-trees, etc., and other foliaceous trees.
